name: web-pricing-plans-and-footer-with-floating-3d-icon-tiles
title: Pricing with a raised blue Pro card and a footer strewn with floating 3D app-icon tiles
whatItIs: A white page with a 'Pricing' pill, 'Simple pricing plans', three cards in which the middle Pro plan is saturated blue and lifted with a lightning tile and a white button while the others are pale with blue buttons, and a grey dotted footer 'Stay organized and boost your productivity' with link columns and scattered 3D icon tiles (calendar, clock, check, flag, bulb, hourglass, chevrons).
whatItMeans: Clear and cheerful; a raised blue plan guides choice and floating icons add play to the footer.
techniques: Raise and colour the recommended plan.
Use a dotted texture in the footer.

vocabulary.definition: A pricing card lifted above the others.
A rendered app-icon tile with soft shadow.
A fine dot pattern as a surface.
A short label on the recommended plan.
